steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I've never seen such dire circumstances for a battle. We face too many restrictions here, and Chief is still trapped.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Try to come up with a counterattack strategy

steps.content: 000 seems to control the entire field. No matter how many monsters you defeat, she can summon more with just a wave of her hand.
Defeating 000 here is almost impossible. Unless...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I remember... EMP caused a major ruckus before.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Me? What ruckus? I don't cause ruckus.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Yes, I remember Hella mentioned that you once disrupted the entire Syndicate power system with only one arrow, causing great chaos.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This city also seems to run on electricity... you can do it.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Are you kidding? That was a once-in-a-lifetime moment. How can I reenact it here?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Unless you are OK with speaking in that funny, cute voice for the rest of your life, in which case, Mess would stick it to you without fail.
Labyrinth pokes EMP, who makes a strange yelp.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: No... I don't want to think about it... A powerful and dashing Sinner like me becoming a clown? No way...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Now it's really you guys forced me to do this!
EMP uses all her strength to shoot an arrow into the sky. A powerful electric current pierces the air, like a thunderstorm descending on the earth.
Instantly, the city plunges into darkness. Yells and exclamations pierce through the glass screen.

steps.speaker: Code Duck
steps.content: Quack?! (What?!)
The duck suddenly wakes up. It gets out of the car and looks really confused.
From a distance, you see it take out its phone, look around, and scratch its head—seemingly at a complete loss as to why it had driven to such a place.
Precisely as you thought.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: ...The duck regained consciousness. The Assassination Field is gone!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The duck... the god is awake now. You lose.
She doesn't respond. She looks toward the horizon, at the dark city regaining lights in the distance, as if listening to something.
You don't know what she sees, but 000 has rarely lost her smile.
Nothing. I just feel a bit regretful.
She looks back at you and smiles again.
This round doesn't count. Someone violated the game rules by overusing Mania and got discovered.
The blackout just now caught the gods' attention. They will soon investigate and find EMP's Mania arrows. Hehe... the consequences should be exciting.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Uh... what... what'll happen?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She's just being a sore loser. If there was such a rule, why didn't she mention it at the start? Why didn't she say anything when she used Mania herself?
I was having so much fun, I forgot.
I'm always careful when I do bad things. I know how to cover my tracks. Even if I kill a god, they won't find any clues. As long as everyone dies without any suspicion of foul play, it's fine.
Want me to teach you some tricks next time?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The target has left, which means your plan has failed. Nothing you say can change that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And I'm not alone in this world anymore. My Sinners are here with me, and you won't have your way from now on.
There's no such thing as "from now on." You've already messed up. If you want to avoid punishment, you have to go back and start over.
Chief, do you know what "restart" means in the game?
In the distance, a loud noise erupts in the direction where "Code Duck" headed. Specks of light slowly gather in 000's palm.
Take a good look. This is a classic game design. When you fail a challenge or make a mistake, it sends you back to a previous save point, giving everyone another chance.
This is its kindest feature. As long as there's still a bit of fight left in you, you can always start over no matter how many times you fail.
She raises her hand, and her body swiftly disintegrates, transforming into a storm that engulfs all of you. The storm disintegrates everything in its path, even freeing you from the phone.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!!
You grab Hecate's hand, but then get separated again. In the final moments of getting swallowed up, you faintly hear her voice.
Get ready. We'll meet at our old spot.
